integrity: Mathematical proof provided, symbolic and numerical checks reproduced; no independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic, normalized T=1,K=1 logistic-feedback resource game with b+d>2; the threshold and critical rate do not assert stochastic extinction, parameter-robustness outside the stated domain, or any result for R(0)=0.
title: An exact sustainability cutoff and universal critical depletion in a logistic-response resource game
